synopsis: Seven-year-old Otoka remembered his past life memories as a Japanese Salaryman after helping two chicks of a monster resembling a chicken called Niwatorisu in the forest. However, the reality was his family was poor and large. There was no room to raise the chicks entrusted to him by the parent Niwatorisu. Three years passed after overcoming his family's opposition. The chicks grew into splendid female Niwatorisus and began to lay precious eggs. Then, this time, his siblings started targeting those eggs...!? "I'm leaving this house already!" Ten-year-old Otoka carries out a midnight flight together with the Mofumofu strongest Niwatorisus he named Shiro-chan and Kuro-chan. In this way, a free-spirited Isekai journey begins with the cute and these strongest fluffy heroines! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

However, without even getting magic training, she was attached to an assault squad, repeatedly fighting on the most cruel battlefields of the "Western Front." The mission given to her was to become the personal medic of the frontline's ace, Garback, and not let him die at any cost. But he turned out to be the worst commander, who will try to get results whatever the cost, even if it means the death of his subordinates! On the battlefield, mired in unreasonable orders and violence, Touri's fierce battle for survival continues...

titleNative: セブンス
synopsis: In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres’s monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family? (Source: J-Novel Club)

Intent on marrying Kotarou, will Hime be able to break through his walls and build a happily-ever-after with him?! (Source: Yen Press)
